title: The text discusses the ongoing tensions and military actions between Uganda and Zaire, particularly focusing on the collaboration between Ugandan President Museveni and Zairean President Mobutu to combat guerrilla movements along their shared border. The situation has led to an influx of Zairean refugees into Uganda due to the ruthless counter-insurgency operations by Zaire's military. Skirmishes have occurred, resulting in casualties on both sides, and high-level meetings have been held to promote peace and security in the border region. Despite allegations of Uganda supporting Zairean rebels, the National Resistance Movement (NRM) has denied these claims. The text also mentions the deployment of Ugandan troops to prevent rebel incursions and the recent bombing of suspected rebel positions by Zairean airforce planes, which raised concerns among local Ugandans.
